messages:
Noah: Starting thread for a new cloud storefront listing kickoff. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure + basic billing SKU set + compliance checklist. Need owners for packaging, legal, and publish infra. Target internal staging by next Tue.
Olga: I'll take packaging and assets (images, screenshots, short descriptions). Will need image specs and the final hero blurb.
Hannah: I'll handle billing text and trial gating rules. Question: do we allow region-selection on the listing or is that only in provisioning?
Diego: Legal triage: I'll review terms, data residency language, and any model license disclosures. Send any third-party model names we plan to surface.
Avery: I'll coordinate publisher access and ensure we have cross-account roles for AWS and service accounts for GCP. Also will own the staging request once preflight is green.
Noah: Great. Marketplace preflight items: SKU file, asset pack, legal manifest, IAM snippets, and a short support playbook.
marketplace-bot: :information_source: Preflight template updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/preflight-v4.md (rev 2024-02-14)
Olga: Upload path: /Shared/marketplace/uploads/1690001111. I'll put hero images + two square logos + 1920x1080 hero screenshot. README will include alt text + credits.
Hannah: Proposed SKUs: RWI-BASE, RWI-SCALE, RWI-ENTERPRISE-TRIAL. Trial SKU will be time-limited (30d). I'll draft pricing copy for subscription and note "hourly bundling coming soon."
Diego: Small ask: avoid exposing "enterprise" in public SKU naming. Suggest RWI-PRO-TR for trial. Also add a short paragraph for "data retention" and "third-party model" checks.
Avery: IAM notes from Eng: for AWS we need a cross-account role with sts:AssumeRole and s3:GetObject. For GCP a service account with roles/storage.objectViewer and roles/compute.viewer. For Azure a managed identity with Storage Blob Data Reader.
Hannah: Adding CTAs: "Start free trial" for trial SKU, "Contact sales" for pro support. Also include a one-line feature bullet list in the CTA area.
Noah: Can someone paste the AWS trust policy snippet? We need it in the publisher ticket.
Avery: AWS trust snippet:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPublisher"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```
Diego: Upload privacy_manifest.pdf to the shared folder once packaging is live. I'll then attach legal_signoff: pending.
Olga: Will upload assets + a tiny prototype screenshot of the console flow.
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: Reminder: Compliance requires signed privacy_manifest.pdf before staging publish.
Noah: Proposed timeline/checkpoints:
- Today: create shared folder + initial SKU CSV
- +24h: assets + pricing draft
- +48h: IAM snippets + legal draft
- +72h: request staging publish
Olga: Can we do a 20-min sync tomorrow 11:00 PT to walk through assets and the listing copy?
Hannah: Works for me.
Diego: I'll be there.
Avery: I'll send invite and attach the preflight checklist. Thanks team :rocket:
